exclusions_declared: Major steel deck repairs exceeding $12,000 allowance
Major wood deck replacement exceeding $8,000 allowance
Replacement of damaged roof drains or leaders (minor adjustments included)
Work outside standard hours (7 AM - 6 PM weekdays)
Hazardous material abatement beyond minor handling (testing included)
Temperature monitoring equipment (can be arranged through owner)
clarifications: Ponding correction: tapered insulation allowance included; final quantity to be confirmed during removal.
Deck conditions: allowances for both steel and wood deck repairs included; should be sufficient based on visual inspection.
Hazardous materials: assumes minimal ACM if any (building is 1998); testing during removal; major abatement would be extra.
Phasing: schedule assumes reasonable cooperation from tenant for access and coordination; significant phasing changes may affect schedule.
HVAC coordination: assumes HVAC shutdowns can be scheduled for weekends when needed; weekday shutdowns require 72-hour notice.
Temperature monitoring: owner to provide or arrange temperature monitoring in warehouse; contractor will coordinate around any alerts.
Permits: building permits typically owner responsibility; contractor can arrange if needed (priced separately).

technical_approach.narrative: Phased occupied-building installation: Phase 1 (Days 1-20) office wing 5,100 sf; Phase 2 (Days 21-50) main roof Section A 20,000 sf; Phase 3 (Days 51-80) main roof Section B 25,000 sf including ponding areas with tapered insulation. Twice-weekly coordination meetings during critical phases. Stated 8 occupied-building roof replacements completed in past 5 years.
technical_approach.tear_off_staging_plan: Maximum 10,000 sq ft exposed at any time; phased by section.
technical_approach.weather_protection_plan: Each phase made watertight by end of work day; weekend protection with reinforced tarps.
technical_approach.fall_protection_plan: Fall protection training for all workers (updated every 2 years); written safety manual; weekly safety meetings; incident reporting and investigation.
technical_approach.waste_disposal_plan: Daily cleanup and debris removal; legal disposal included; lead flashings separated and disposed of as hazardous waste.
technical_approach.hazmat_approach: Visual inspection during removal; if hazardous materials suspected, work pauses for testing; minor ACM handling included; major abatement would be extra; lead flashings handled as hazmat.

extraction_notes.issue: Bid does not name a single manufacturer for the supplied TPO system. Three certifications are listed (Carlisle Syntec, Firestone Building Products, Johns Manville) but no specific system is identified. The '20-Year NDL Warranty Sample Documentation' attachment is referenced but the manufacturer issuing the NDL is unstated.
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Confirm which manufacturer's TPO system will be supplied and obtain the matching system warranty letter (not a generic sample).

extraction_notes.issue: Bid states '20-year NDL' but does not attach a system-warranty document — only 'sample' documentation. Per the warranty taxonomy, this is recorded as 'ndl' (not total_system_ndl) because the prerequisites for total-system NDL (named certified installer for the supplied system, pre-install drawing review, manufacturer mid-job inspection) are not evidenced.
extraction_notes.evidence: WARRANTY section; ATTACHMENTS list ('20-Year NDL Warranty Sample Documentation')
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Request the actual manufacturer NDL warranty form (not a sample) tied to the proposed system, and confirm whether labour to reinstall is covered or only material replacement.

extraction_notes.issue: Bid does not specify wind uplift coverage in mph.
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Request stated wind-uplift coverage from manufacturer warranty.

extraction_notes.issue: No bid bond or bonding capacity is referenced in the submission or in the ATTACHMENTS list. (Note: per /roof-review-output protocol, whether this is a mandatory failure depends on the RFP §6.2 submission requirements — defer to wave-2 qualification check.)
extraction_notes.evidence: ATTACHMENTS list; INSURANCE COVERAGE section silent on bonding
extraction_notes.owner_followup: If RFP requires bid bond, request from bidder or treat as compliance gap.

extraction_notes.issue: WSIB Clearance Certificate is listed as attached but the certificate's issue/expiry date is not transcribed in the cover letter narrative.
extraction_notes.evidence: ATTACHMENTS list; INSURANCE COVERAGE section names account number 5678901-23 only
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Confirm WSIB clearance is current (within 60 days of bid open) by reviewing the attached certificate.

extraction_notes.issue: Bid declares CGL $5M per occurrence but does not state completed-operations tail length.
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Verify completed operations period meets RFP minimum (typically 2 years) on COI.

extraction_notes.issue: Bid does not state whether Tenebrus Capital is named as additional insured on the contractor's CGL.
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Inspect attached COI to confirm owner is named as additional insured.

extraction_notes.issue: No statement of CRCA membership; no count of Skilled Trades Ontario C of Q-holding roofers on crew. Cover letter cites '3 certified roofing technicians' (manufacturer-certified, not necessarily Skilled Trades C of Q).
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Request CRCA membership confirmation and explicit C of Q holder count if material to evaluation.

extraction_notes.issue: Bid does not provide unit pricing for deck replacement (per bf), flashing (per lf), or insulation (per sqft per R-value). Allowances are flat-dollar.
extraction_notes.owner_followup: If extras over allowance are likely, request unit-rate schedule for extras/deducts pricing.

extraction_notes.issue: Mobilization days after award and crew size are not stated; only fixed start (May 1) and end (August 5) dates given.
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Confirm mobilization lead time and crew size for owner facility planning.

extraction_notes.issue: Bid states 'meeting all specified requirements' (cover letter para 2) but contains nine exclusions and seven clarifications. Recorded as full compliance per cover-letter language; flag the inconsistency for wave-2 technical review.
extraction_notes.evidence: Cover letter paragraph 2; EXCLUSIONS and CLARIFICATIONS AND ASSUMPTIONS sections
extraction_notes.owner_followup: Wave-2: reconcile each exclusion/clarification against RFP spec to confirm true compliance.
